schema_version: 1
stream: LEARNING_PLANNER_EVENTS
delivery: at_least_once
producer: ms-go-learning-planner
subjects:
  - {name: course.plan.completed, schema_versions: [1, 2], current_schema_version: 2}
  - {name: course.plan.failed, schema_versions: [1, 2], current_schema_version: 2}
  - {name: planner.onboarding-path.outcome.v1, schema_version: 1}
onboarding_path_outcome_statuses: [PATH_READY, ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS, STATE_CHANGED]
envelope: [event_id, event_type, correlation_id, causation_id, student_id, occurred_at, schema_version, data]
deduplication_key: event_id
transactional_outbox: planner_outbox
v2_addition: data.learning_path_id is present only when an exact path was supplied or allocated
compatibility: existing v1 rows remain publishable; consumers must tolerate v2 before producer rollout
forbidden_payload: [prompt variables, generated content, mastery detail, raw evidence, provider response, chain-of-thought]
exact_path_conflict: course.plan.failed data.failure_code is LEARNING_PATH_COMMAND_CONFLICT after a delivered Student 409
checkpoint_privacy: exact command payload and hash remain request-row audit data and never enter the event
consumer:
  ms-go-teacher-agent: TEACHER source uses a durable inbox; a present dialog audit reference enables idempotent Dialog append, while Student and System sources have no Teacher state

incoming_diagnostic_result:
  producer: ms-go-student
  subject: student.diagnostic-result.committed.v1
  schema_version: 1
  stream: STUDENT_DIAGNOSTIC_EVENTS
  stream_policy: file workqueue; max_age 0; max_msgs -1; max_bytes 1073741824; discard new; duplicates 10 minutes; replicas 1
  durable: ms-learning-planner-diagnostic-placement-v1
  consumer_policy: deliver all; explicit ACK; max_deliver -1; ack_wait 30 seconds; max_ack_pending 1
  envelope: [event_id, event_type, correlation_id, causation_id, student_id, occurred_at, schema_version, data]
  data: [plan_id, plan_revision, plan_digest, result_digest]
  identity: deterministic SHA1 URL namespace UUID over subject + ':' + plan_id
  correlation_id: plan_id equals attempt_id
  causation_id: completion request UUID
  occurred_at: canonical UTC microsecond Student result.CompletedAt
  required_matching_headers: [X-Event-ID, X-Correlation-ID, X-Causation-ID, X-Schema-Version]
  admission: exact subject/schema; bounded body and headers; reject extra/duplicate/null/missing event fields; own frozen plan plus Student aggregate digest binding before mutation
  receipt: existing immutable diagnostic placement; matching receipt validates replay without Student read
  ack: only after placement commit or legitimate validated receipt replay
  invalid: Term without placement mutation
  transient: NAK after 2 seconds; unlimited redelivery
  startup: existing NATS_URL; required preprovisioned compatible stream; no default-off flag; never reset/add/update shared stream
  shutdown: cancel/wait own loop; unsubscribe preserving durable; close owned connection
  forbidden_payload: [score, band, answers, mastery, progress, profile]

incoming_planning_state:
  producer: ms-go-student
  subject: student.planning-state.changed.v1
  schema_version: 1
  stream: STUDENT_PLANNING_STATE_EVENTS
  stream_policy: file workqueue; max_age0; max_msgs-1; max_bytes1073741824; discardnew; duplicates10min; replicas1
  durable: ms-learning-planner-hybrid-replan-v1
  envelope: [event_id, event_type, correlation_id, causation_id, student_id, occurred_at, schema_version, data]
  data: [learning_path_id, path_version, trigger_kind, trigger_identity, targets]
  target_refs: bounded exact existing Student identity vocabulary; no body or score
  receipt: immutable event_id plus payload hash; changed replay conflicts
  acknowledgement: after durable inbox and coalesced per-student-path work commit; duplicate receipt needs no owner read
  evaluation: fetch latest coherent Student snapshot; unique snapshot_ref plus hybrid-replan-v1 job
  coalescing: generation and worker claim preserve newer events arriving during snapshot fetch/checkpoint
  event_effect: queue only; no Student or Runtime mutation
  startup: compatible preprovisioned dedicated stream required; never mutate shared stream
  recovery: unlimited delayed NAK for transient receipt failure; durable work remains retryable through owner outage or restart
